title: web UI: show dependency titles and status on cards, not just ids
description: Cards render each dependency as a bare arrow-and-id (e.g. the link reading just 20) with no title or status, in the taskCard deps loop of pkg/webui/assets/app.js. The editor typeahead already shows id plus title, so cards are inconsistent and force a click to learn what a dependency is. Show the parent title (truncated) and indicate whether each parent is closed (satisfied) or still open (blocking), with a tooltip. Consider also surfacing reverse links: which tasks this one blocks.
